sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Ethnographic paper; 'Language' paragraph (p. 6) says only that neither tribe at the Tapajós mouth spoke Tupi, that Bettendorff translated the catechism into the Urucucú language (translation lost) and that Heriarte said the Orucucuzes spoke a language distinct from the Tupinambaranas'. Not one Urucucú word is recorded; no phonology, no stress.
